scope: Disposable isolated Fizzy six-request companion only, NOT production inputs or blog authority

controls.secret_key_base: lowrail-disposable-blog-companion-only- repeated four times; DUMMY disabled
controls.random: Per-workflow, per-declared-site Random seeded with SHA256(seed/scenario ID/site); streams continue over session round trips; integer bytes, not OpenSSL RNG reseeding
controls.runtime: Only Rack::Runtime#call's two Rack::Utils.clock_time reads per request return successive 0.001-second inputs; real reads retained separately; x-runtime remains a literal compared header, not a performance measurement
controls.session: Legacy GETs fresh; breadth workflows retain actual encrypted cookies and submit the natural form's CSRF/_method inputs. No security certification
controls.state: Same closed four-SQLite-file snapshot and cleared tmp before each sequential worker; each additional breadth case is a new worker, not a rollback hiding after_commit effects
controls.wall_clock: Breadth companions only: every Time.now read on the active scenario thread returns the declared fixed epoch; real reads and call sites retained separately. Includes AR timestamps, job enqueued_at and cookie expiry; raw and legacy GET wall clocks remain real
